description: An MLOps engineer is setting up secure access to a remote artifact repository to track machine learning experiments. The engineer needs to generate an SSH keypair for authentication and ensure the public key is added to the remote server. Generate an RSA SSH keypair using ssh-keygen, save the private key as /home/user/.ssh/id_rsa_exp with no passphrase, and the public key as /home/user/.ssh/id_rsa_exp.pub. Set the correct file permissions (private key: 600, public key: 644). Then, use ssh-copy-id to append the public key to the ~/.ssh/authorized_keys file on the remote server artifacts.example.com as the user "mluser". The task should be completed in 2-3 terminal commands. The final state must include the key files with exact filenames and permissions, and the public key content must match the standard SSH RSA format (e.g., "ssh-rsa AAAAB3..." followed by a comment).
